item.title: The FPV Drones Delivering Astonishing 2026 Winter Olympics Pictures
item.description: Cinewhoop FPV drones are reshaping Winter Olympics coverage, delivering immersive, high-speed perspectives that bring viewers closer to athletes than ever before.

item.title: Apple Studio Display 2 Rumors: Mini-LED, 90 Hz Refresh Rate, and 2026 Launch?
item.description: The current Apple Studio Display launched in 2022 and has remained largely unchanged since, despite growing pressure from third-party displays offering better features. The next version appears designed to address several of those shortcomings.

item.title: True Lens Services Vega65: New 65mm Cine Lens Set
item.description: True Lens Services has introduced Vega65, a new large-format cine lens series designed and built entirely in-house by the UK optics specialist.

item.description: ZEISS has introduced the new Aatma, a set of nine high-end full frame T1.5 cinema primes (18mm, 25mm, 35mm, 40mm, 50mm, 65mm, 85mm, 100mm, and 135mm).

item.title: BSC Expo 2026 and HPA Tech Retreat 2026: Cameras, AI, and Industry Trends
item.description: Two very different events are just about to kick-off, the 2026 BSC Expo in London and the 2026 HPA Tech Retreat in Palm Springs. Both are important to the industry in different ways.
